title: Windows packaging (NSIS + MSIX)
intent: Produce installable Windows artifacts with icons and file/protocol associations.
checklist: NSIS installer (per-user + per-machine option) with icon + shortcuts
MSIX target configured for Store distribution
teslasync:// protocol association registered by the installer
Uninstaller removes app data appropriately
Artifacts produced and launchable

title: macOS packaging (dmg + pkg, hardened runtime)
intent: Produce macOS artifacts with hardened runtime + entitlements.
checklist: dmg + pkg targets with background + icon
Hardened runtime enabled; entitlements.plist (no debug entitlements in prod)
Universal (arm64 + x64) build
teslasync:// protocol + document types in Info.plist
Artifacts produced and launchable (note: notarization is a separate unit)

title: Linux packaging (AppImage + deb + rpm)
intent: Cover the platform the native trio doesn't (the core rationale in DIVERGENCE.md).
checklist: AppImage, deb, and rpm targets
.desktop entry + icon theme integration
teslasync:// MIME/protocol handler registered
Sandbox/chrome-sandbox handled correctly
Artifacts produced and launchable

title: Windows Authenticode signing
intent: Sign installers + binaries so SmartScreen/AV trust them.
checklist: Code-signing config (cert from secure secret, never committed)
All exe/dll + installer signed; signature verifies
Timestamp server configured
If no cert is available on this host → BLOCKED with reason (not done)

title: macOS codesign + notarization + staple
checklist: codesign with Developer ID + hardened runtime
notarytool submission + stapling
spctl/Gatekeeper assessment passes
Requires a macOS runner + Apple credentials → BLOCKED here if absent (not done)

title: Auto-update feed + channels (electron-updater)
intent: Signed update feed with stable/beta channels and staged rollout.
checklist: Publish provider (generic/S3/GitHub Releases) with latest.yml per OS
Stable + beta channels selectable
Update signatures verified before install
Staged rollout / minimum-version support
End-to-end: an older build updates to a newer one

title: End-to-end suite (Playwright _electron)
intent: Cover the critical desktop flows against the packaged app.
checklist: Launch → auth → dashboard renders real data
SSE live update + offline/reconnect banner
Native menu + tray quick action navigates
Export via native save dialog writes a file
Deep link opens the correct route
Runs headless in CI on all three OSes

title: Performance budgets (startup, memory, bundle)
intent: Measure and enforce desktop perf so the app stays snappy.
checklist: Cold start to interactive measured + budget enforced
Idle + active memory budget enforced
Renderer/main bundle size budget enforced
v8 snapshot / lazy-loading where it helps
Budget regressions fail CI

title: Accessibility audit (desktop shell)
intent: Keyboard nav, screen reader, and contrast across the native chrome + embedded web.
checklist: Full keyboard navigation incl. menus, tray actions, dialogs
Screen reader labels for native chrome (menu/tray/notifications)
Focus management on window/dialog open + deep-link nav
Contrast honored in light/dark title bar + chrome
No a11y regressions vs the web app

title: Localization completeness (native chrome)
intent: Every native string (menus, tray, notifications, dialogs, About) is localized.
checklist: No hardcoded native strings (scan passes)
All locales the web app supports are covered for native chrome
Pluralization/format parity with web i18n
Locale switch updates native chrome without restart where possible

title: Security review (Electronegativity + fuses + CSP + IPC)
intent: Final pass: prove the app meets Electron security best practices.
checklist: Electronegativity scan clean (no HIGH findings)
@electron/fuses verified on the packaged app
CSP audited; no unsafe-eval/inline beyond documented web needs
Every IPC channel validates sender + input
No secrets in the bundle; dependency CVE scan clean

title: Release workflow + GA gate
intent: One workflow produces signed, notarized, auto-updatable releases for all three OSes.
checklist: Tag-triggered release builds win/mac/linux artifacts
Signing + notarization wired (or BLOCKED with documented missing creds)
Update feed published; changelog generated
All E5 ledger rows are status=done (or honestly blocked with reasons)
GA checklist (DIVERGENCE.md acknowledged) recorded in the log
